score_notes.A: Coherent arc (intro -> six lineages -> cross-cutting failure modes -> comparison -> open problems -> conclusion), no body H1, no skipped levels. Math markup breaks blog rules: single $ inside display math L237 `\beta_{\text{bo$n$}}`; stray trailing `\\` inside $$ at L395; pipe conditionals `\rho(y|x)` L110, `\mu(.|x)` L359, `|x` L557, `\cdot|\mathbf{x}` L585.
score_notes.B: Mostly natural 입니다 register. Calque the rubric names: L323 '보상에 대한 손실을 정책에 대한 손실로 바꾼 것입니다' (rewrite: '보상을 맞추던 손실을 정책을 직접 맞추는 손실로 바꾼 것입니다'). Formulaic '~셈입니다' x5 (L80, L162, L191, L435, L650) and '이 글의 판단으로는' x4 (L259, L626, L738, L758). Tangled L17 '정책이 SFT 모델에서 너무 멀어지지 않도록 KL 페널티의 기준으로 삼는 이 SFT 모델, 즉 참조 모델(reference model)까지 덜어 낸 목적함수들입니다'; L461 'Reddit TL;DR 요약 데이터셋의 선호 쌍처럼 생긴 가상의 요약 선호 쌍에 대입하면 ... 예를 들어 가상의 경우로'. English left in table cells: L763 '5k offline vs mock', L764 'GPU-days'.
score_notes.C: The running TL;DR pair carries the transitions well. Dangling back-reference L537 '앞서 소개한 Chatbot Arena 순위 상승도' (Chatbot Arena is never mentioned before). L787 '반대 방향의 증거도 같은 그림을 그립니다' gives alignment-tax evidence that does not point the opposite way. The same findings come back section after section, which reads as stitched fragments (see facts-once).
score_notes.D: Good worked examples at the hard steps: BT loss L74, KL-penalised reward L114, Gao peak L243, DPO gradient weight L337, RRHF vs SimPO margin L461/L535, SPPO target L594, GRPO advantages L650. Hard steps are not padded much.
score_notes.E: Timeline table plus one comparison table, equations wherever a mechanism is defined. 42 figures, several with a one-sentence gloss that adds nothing (L90, L281, L405, L531) and paired near-duplicate plots (L82/L86 MuJoCo/Atari). Bad comparison-table cells: L766 limitation '-', L766 result in prose ('온라인 혼합 데이터 정책 선호'), L764 '12B?', L762 says the same thing twice ('MuJoCo 사람 700 질의 (MuJoCo 8개 과제, 700 질의)').
score_notes.F: Three cases at -2 each. (1) L128 reverses the source: the post says '보상 부호를 뒤집는 버그가 KL 페널티 부호까지 뒤집지는 않아서', but 1909.08593 §4.4 says 'the same bug also flipped the sign of the KL penalty'. (2) L126 credits the 96%/84% preference rates to labeler-heuristic exploitation ('이 높은 수치가 라벨러의 휴리스틱을 악용한 결과일 수 있다고 의심'). The paper attributes the copying behaviour to labelers checking for copying; it does not say the heuristic explains the rates. (3) L764 table cell '1.3B RLHF vs 12B? SFT' is a guessed model size with a question mark; the paper says '10× its size'. Also: KL written with `\mid\mid` at L313 (should be `\|`). L801 '어느 계보도 제시하지 못했습니다' is a literature-wide claim with no support.

claim_headings.evidence: All headings are noun phrases (e.g. L425 '보상 모델이 없어도 KL 예산을 따라 되돌아오는 과최적화'); none is in 다-form. A few H3 are topic labels: L257 '파이프라인이 남긴 것', L799 '추론 능력의 손실'.

running_example.evidence: The Reddit TL;DR preference pair is set up at L15 and followed through RLHF L146, DPO L337, KTO L399, NLHF L551, online IPO L573, GRPO L662 and the synthesis L746/L809.

mechanism_design_formula_example.evidence: e.g. DPO L311-337: problem, closed-form inversion, loss, numeric gradient example; GRPO L634-650.

facts_said_once.evidence: DAA over-optimisation is restated at L427, L541, L736, L748 and L811. SimPO reward-hacking risk at L539, L736, L752 and L779. Ziegler copying at L126, L716 and L797. 320 GPU-days at L154 and L259. KTO's no-SFT DPO verbosity at L417 and L730. SPPO's Mistral leaderboard decline at L602, L754 and L797. RLAIF's no gain from combining at L722 and L797.

numbers_scoped.evidence: Most numbers carry model/benchmark/setting (e.g. L602). Exceptions: L764 '12B?'; L767 'RM 12M 등' (the paper holds the RM fixed at 12M).

nothing_invented.evidence: Hypothetical examples are marked '가상의' throughout. But L128 inverts the KL-sign fact and L801 makes an unsupported field-wide claim.

writer_assessment_at_end.evidence: L813 chooses methods by failure mode rather than benchmark rank; L758 gives selection criteria.

length_fitted.evidence: About 71.8k non-space characters, 842 lines and 42 figures. The density is justified for 22 papers, but repetition inflates it.

type_specific_shape.evidence: The survey has the required timeline, lineage sections, cross-cutting section, comparison table and synthesis. But the rule that numbers live in one table is not met: nearly every table number is first given in the body (DPO 61/57 at L349 and L770; KTO +13.5 at L423 and L774; SPPO 28.52 at L602 and L777; Iterative DPO 31.3 at L622 and L778).

korean_style.evidence: The 입니다 register holds and subjects are explicit. Formulaic '셈입니다'/'이 글의 판단으로는' and the 에 대한 calque at L323 remain.

top_issues: L128 reverses a source fact: Ziegler et al. say the bug ALSO flipped the KL-penalty sign; the post says it did not.
L126 repeats the checklist misattribution: it credits the 96%/84% preference rates to labeler-heuristic exploitation (copy-explains-preference).

The comparison table has defective cells: '-' (L766), prose result (L766), '12B?' guess (L764), English setting strings (L763/L764). Almost every table number also appears in the body, which breaks the survey rule that numbers live in one table.

Facts restated across sections: DAA over-optimisation 5x, SimPO reward-hacking 4x, Ziegler copying 3x, SPPO Mistral decline 3x. This inflates an already very long post (about 72k non-space characters, 42 figures).

Blog markup and math: single $ inside $$ (L237), stray `\\` (L395), `\mid\mid` for KL (L313), bare `|` conditionals; the dangling back-reference to Chatbot Arena (L537); L801's unsupported field-wide claim.
